state.background: Phase 2 moves 89 partial Playwright assertions to Vitest Browser Mode in five batches; consolidated full E2E is run after each 20 migrated rows. Batch 1 covers exactly these 20 stable IDs: p45-a-a11y-sheet-tab-trap; p45-a-cagr-sheet-02, -03, -04, -05, -06, -07, -08, -09; p45-a-cpi-legend-scroll; p45-a-cpi-tooltip-rows; p45-a-earnings-hover; p45-a-earnings-hidden-series-hover; p45-a-legend-entertainment-series9; p45-a-legend-food-nominal; p45-a-legend-dark-all12; p45-b-monthly-boundary-axis-21-cpi-2017-12-2018-1-svg; p45-b-monthly-boundary-axis-21-earnings-2017-12-2018-1-svg; p45-b-range-change-107-e2e; p45-b-range-change-187-e2e-1. The 18 extant route assertions now have production-route Browser Mode coverage through a Vitest custom command and isolated Playwright page. The two monthly label source assertions were already deleted historically; existing Browser Mode assertions were retained and tagged with stable IDs, and the roster records this source reconciliation rather than claiming an E2E removal.
acceptanceCriteria: Sheet tab trapping keeps focus in the dialog; CAGR scenarios preserve calculation/result, coordinate backdrop close, 375x667 overflow/chart visibility/internal scroll/note geometry, and landscape note geometry.
CPI legend toggling preserves window scroll; visible tooltip keeps the 12-key row/root/order/display-label/value contract; hidden-series hover preserves tooltip behavior.
Earnings hover and hidden-series rehover preserve tooltip/separator behavior.
Entertainment and nominal-food swatches match their CSS tokens; dark mode preserves all 12 legend colors.
Monthly boundary label Browser Mode cases preserve CPI and earnings assertions; their historical E2E source absence is explicitly documented.
Range sanity compares production chart contracts with rendered bars; the single-year 2017 route uses its URL and four-period contract.
Only matching migrated E2E predicates are removed; distinct generic CPI smoke, CAGR route-entry check, and the separate 2017-2018 eight-period range assertion remain.
verification: `pnpm run test:browser:next-route-poc`: production build succeeded; 2 test files passed, 20 tests passed.
Focused Batch 1 component Browser Mode command: 26 test files passed; 95 tests passed, 9 skipped.
`pnpm test:e2e`: full suite completed; 99 passed, 19 skipped, 118 total.

`pnpm type-check`: exits 2 on existing Browser Mode spec diagnostics (Playwright locator typing, older CSS raw import/data casts, strokeOpacity); the new Batch 1 route test diagnostics were eliminated.
knownConstraints: This review covers Batch 1 only; rows 21–89 remain untouched and partial.
The two monthly-boundary source E2E assertions were already deleted before this batch, so their Browser Mode coverage is tagged and recorded without retroactive deletion claims.
Type-check remains blocked by diagnostics in pre-existing Browser Mode specs; build TypeScript phase, lint, Browser Mode, and full E2E passed.

state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For a reason choice, give a case-specific finding, affected file or acceptance criterion, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied implementation and verification evidence support marking these 20 Batch 1 rows fully transferred and proceeding to Batch 2? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: All 20 source predicates have equivalent Browser Mode coverage or explicit historical-source reconciliation, matching E2E predicates were removed, and verification supports the checkpoint.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A migration requirement or predicate mapping conflicts with intent; identify the requirement and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A required prerequisite is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Implementation details or verification evidence are insufficient; identify what is missing.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation defect exists; identify its file, evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The batch exceeds or falls outside its agreed 20-row scope; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the listed categories; identify its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
